items.question: Which subtype has the highest average ESR1?

attempts.sql: SELECT pam50_subtype, AVG(ge.log2_expr) AS avg_esr1 FROM clinical c JOIN rna_samples rs ON c.patient_id = rs.patient_id JOIN gene_expression ge ON rs.sample_id = ge.sample_id WHERE rs.sample_type_code = '01' AND ge.gene_symbol = 'ESR1' GROUP BY pam50_subtype ORDER BY avg_esr1 DESC LIMIT 1;
attempts.reason: Subtype and ESR1 expression are available; query computes average ESR1 by subtype and returns the highest.

items.final_sql: SELECT pam50_subtype, AVG(ge.log2_expr) AS avg_esr1 FROM clinical c JOIN rna_samples rs ON c.patient_id = rs.patient_id JOIN gene_expression ge ON rs.sample_id = ge.sample_id WHERE rs.sample_type_code = '01' AND ge.gene_symbol = 'ESR1' GROUP BY pam50_subtype ORDER BY avg_esr1 DESC LIMIT 1;
items.reference_sql: SELECT c.pam50_subtype FROM gene_expression g JOIN rna_samples s ON s.sample_id = g.sample_id JOIN clinical c ON c.patient_id = g.patient_id WHERE g.gene_symbol = 'ESR1' AND s.sample_type_code = '01' AND c.pam50_subtype IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.pam50_subtype ORDER BY AVG(g.log2_expr) DESC LIMIT 1
